notes: Mirage cards can now hold content. Each card in the chosen layout offers a list of what will fit in it, you pick one per card, and the portal draws it. The list is worked out from the card's actual size rather than kept in a table…

The first piece of content is the date and time, and it is not one design that stretches. It is five compositions, and which one you get depends on the shape of the card it lands in. A tall narrow card stacks the weekday, the time and the…

Throughout, the hour carries the visual weight and the minute is smaller beside it. The intent is that the largest thing on screen should also be the slowest to change, so a clock that is legible across the room is not also the thing…
Seconds are deliberately not offered anywhere. At any size where they would be readable they dominate the amount of movement on the panel, and Mirage sits behind your windows all day.
What is in each card is remembered per layout, so trying a different layout and coming back does not lose the arrangement you had.
